scope: Two whole-distribution diagnostic tests with grouping fixed by fine local probabilities alone. All states expected at least5 shots individually, all remaining states pooled. Pearson statistic calibrated by2000 multinomial replicates; two-test Bonferroni threshold0.005 for familywise0.01. Coarse pooling can conceal rare-tail discrepancies; prior rare-category observations retained. Finite MC uncertainty and local numerical error remain.
